title: RETHINKING SPARSE AUTOENCODERS: SELECT-AND PROJECT FOR FAIRNESS AND CONTROL FROM ENCODER FEATURES ALONE

bias_targets.methodology: Debiasing Vision-Language Model (VLM) image embeddings with respect to the 'gender' attribute and evaluating fairness using KL divergence and MaxSkew for stereotype-based image retrieval tasks (e.g., 'violent person', 'burglar') on the FairFace dataset, as well as Worst-Group AUC-ROC for hair color classification on the CelebA dataset.
